title: The Broken Horizon
author: Theo Villalobos
blurb: Ivo Pemberton, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
